item.text: The Zebra Finch file has 19,698 measurement rows plus one header. The relevant field is `MethylationPercentage` (column 8), so the removed set is the strict-complement interval `10 ≤ methylation ≤ 90`; values exactly 10 or 90 are removed because the retained rule is strictly `<10` or `>90`. The seed history has been copied, and I’m now running the CSV conversion and row filtering in that copy.
